scope: Current browsable shots with persisted Cull Swipe human ratings; one JPG/RAW capture group counts once, not a lifetime usage total.

method.pairing: Retained same-shot XMP metadata; all paired AI ratings predate the human ratings.

limitations: Personal-use observational sample, not random or blinded; AI ratings were visible during human review.
Unpaired records are excluded from both metric denominators and correctness judgments.
This snapshot does not establish a reduction in human review time or a general VLM accuracy rate.
A legacy whole-sidecar human write can overwrite the original AI score; a missing retained pair does not establish that AI never scored that shot.
Only one paired example has AI score 1 and eight have AI score 2; their within-range rates do not establish performance on a broader sample.
evaluation: Human outcome falls within the allowed range for its AI score; neither exact-star agreement nor a binary reject prediction.
